text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Now, it's our turn, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all, Top Road!
Yeah, let's give it our all, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Leading up to this day, I've devoted 
myself entirely to basic training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to give it everything I've got. 
A run worthy of my Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Here I go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I send them off with complete trust. It's 
true that we're still inexperienced. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer straightforward dedication to 
running is second to none. It was a race 
where that very resolve was put to the 
test.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(So this is... the paddock... The pressure 
is immense...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, my body's trembling... But...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I won't run away! I won't look down! I'll 
do everything I possibly can with all my 
might!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Top Road! Looking forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Top Road, Madam President!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: "Everyone came to watch! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Are those people over there... 
everyone from our class!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Even though you're busy, you went out of 
your way... And you even brought a 
banner..."

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Expectations...! So many people are 
counting on me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have this... I've got nothing 
to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Please watch, Trainer-san! Everyone! I—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely live up to your 
expectations!
